per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "sp"."power_name" FROM "superpower" "sp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" "hp" ON "sp"."id" = "hp"."power_id" INNER JOIN "superhero" "sh" ON "hp"."hero_id" = "sh"."id" WHERE "sh"."superhero_name" = '3-D Man' LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Among the superheroes with the super power of "Super Strength", how many of them have a height of over 200cm?

per_case_results.actual_sql:

per_case_results.question: Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power of "Agility"?

per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."id") FROM "superhero" "s" JOIN "colour" "c" ON "s"."eye_colour_id" = "c"."id" JOIN "hero_power" "hp" ON "hp"."hero_id" = "s"."id" JOIN "superpower" "sp" ON "hp"."power_id" = "sp"."id" WHERE "c"."colour" = 'Blue' AND "sp"."power_name" = 'Agility'

per_case_results.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC NULLS LAST) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "s"."superhero_name", "s"."height_cm" FROM "superhero" "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' ORDER BY "s"."height_cm" DESC LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting with the most common color.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT colour.colour AS EyeColor, COUNT(superhero.id) AS Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(superhero.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS PopularityRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY colour.colour
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "c"."colour", COUNT("s"."id") AS "hero_count"
FROM "superhero" AS "s"
INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id"
INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s"."eye_colour_id" = "c"."id"
WHERE "p"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY "c"."colour"
ORDER BY "hero_count" DESC
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code? Indicate how many of the said superheroes were published by Marvel Comics.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero), 0)), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.alignment_id WHERE T3.alignment = 'Bad'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "a"."alignment" = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT("s"."id") AS "percentage", SUM(CASE WHEN "a"."alignment" = 'Bad' AND "p"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "marvel_bad_count" FROM "superhero" "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" LEFT JOIN "publisher" "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Between DC and Marvel Comics, which publisher has published more superheroes? Find the difference in the number of superheroes they have published.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'DC Comics' END AS "publisher", ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "publisher" ON "superhero"."publisher_id" = "publisher"."id" WHERE "publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "s"."power_name" FROM "hero_power" "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" "s" ON "hp"."power_id" = "s"."id" WHERE "hp"."hero_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "superhero" WHERE "superhero_name" = 'Abomination') LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question: Which hero was the fastest?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "s"."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" AS "s"
INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha"."hero_id" = "s"."id"
INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a"."id" = "ha"."attribute_id"
WHERE "a"."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY "ha"."attribute_value" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: Which superheroes have blue eyes with brown hair?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "superhero_name" FROM "superhero" WHERE "eye_colour_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "colour" WHERE "colour" = 'Blue') AND "hair_colour_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "colour" WHERE "colour" = 'Brown') LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: What is the publisher for Hawkman, Karate Kid and Speedy?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "s"."superhero_name", "p"."publisher_name" FROM "superhero" "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id" WHERE "s"."superhero_name" IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy') LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question: Calculate the percentage of superheroes with blue eyes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "eye_colour_id" = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT("id")) * 100 AS "percentage" FROM "superhero"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Find the ratio between male superheroes and female superheroes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Male' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "gender_id" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN "gender_id" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ratio" FROM "superhero"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: In superheroes with missing weight data, calculate the difference between the number of superheroes with blue eyes and no eye color.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "c"."colour" = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "c"."colour" = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "difference"
FROM "superhero" "s"
INNER JOIN "colour" "c" ON "s"."eye_colour_id" = "c"."id"
WHERE "s"."weight_kg" = 0 OR "s"."weight_kg" IS NULL
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: How many green-skinned villains are there in the superhero universe?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad' AND T3.colour = 'Green'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" s JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id" JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id" WHERE c."colour" = 'Green' AND a."alignment" = 'Bad'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Identify superheroes who can control wind and list their names in alphabetical order.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name NULLS FIRST
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "s"."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" "s"
INNER JOIN "hero_power" "hp" ON "hp"."hero_id" = "s"."id"
WHERE "hp"."power_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "attribute" WHERE "attribute_name" = 'Wind Control')
ORDER BY "s"."superhero_name" ASC
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Identify the gender of the superhero who has the ability of Phoenix Force.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T4.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T1.gender_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "g"."gender" FROM "superhero" "s" INNER JOIN "gender" "g" ON "s"."gender_id" = "g"."id" INNER JOIN "hero_power" "hp" ON "hp"."hero_id" = "s"."id" INNER JOIN "attribute" "a" ON "a"."id" = "hp"."power_id" WHERE "a"."attribute_name" = 'Phoenix Force' LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question: Which publisher created more superheroes: DC or Marvel Comics? Find the difference in the number of superheroes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "difference",
       CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Marvel Comics' END AS "publisher"
FROM "superhero" "s"
INNER JOIN "publisher" "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id"
WHERE "p"."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
LIMIT 500
